name: Tosa (Japan, city)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tosa city emblem in yellow: a stylised device of a loop with two curved horns.
history: Municipal flag of Tosa, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Tosa city emblem — a stylised device of a loop with two curved horns
